nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-facing guide to the packages/ directory: lists package categories (core infrastructure, domain, integration, language analysis, frontend) with common Nx commands and embedded Packmind coding standards such as TypeORM repository rules.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code instructions for the packages/ directory describing each package category, environment tags and import boundaries, package layout, and cross-package conventions, pointing to architecture rules under packages/.claude/rules/packmind/.
nodes.languageNotes: Near-duplicate of packages/AGENTS.md but more current (e.g. recipes renamed to commands, feature-flags and playbook-change-applier packages listed).

nodes.name: packmind-lock.json
nodes.summary: Packmind CLI lockfile for the packages/ scope recording installed playbook packages (@backend/backend, hexagonal architecture standards), the target coding agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, AGENTS.md, etc.) and pinned artifact versions with ids and space ids.

nodes.name: packmind.json
nodes.summary: Packmind CLI manifest declaring which playbook packages (@backend/backend and its hexagonal architecture standards) are installed for the packages/ directory.
